readings: Considering only advanced behaviour analyses whose linked transaction record and trader both exist, count for each trader type (`tradekind`) the number of distinct transactions analysed (a transaction analysed twice counts once), and that count's share of the total of these counts over all trader types. For the trader types whose count is strictly above the average count across trader types, give in one row the sum of their counts, the average of their shares, and the average amount by which their counts exceed that average count, without rounding.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
stats AS (
  SELECT *,
         CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share,
         AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt
  FROM counts
)
SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess
FROM stats
WHERE cnt > avg_cnt;
